versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release of Tool Battery Charging Roster.

- Organizes cordless tool batteries and chargers into a clear, printable roster.
- Includes battery and charger labeling, rotation order, storage location, and status tracking (full, charging, used, inspect, retire).
- Provides practical, basic fire-safe charging reminders without electrical repair or modification guidance.
- Supports easy compatibility checks; uncertain items are marked “hold for manual check”.
- Output includes session closeout checklist and a mini station card for quick reference.
